## Summary

What does this pull request change, and why?

## Area

- [ ] Standard text
- [ ] Prompt / behavior instructions
- [ ] MCP / tool contract
- [ ] Python reference implementation
- [ ] Benchmark / evaluation
- [ ] Documentation / adoption guide
- [ ] Governance / community

## Human autonomy and proportionality

- [ ] This change does not make decisions for the user.
- [ ] This change avoids coercive or shaming language.
- [ ] This change preserves proportionality for low-impact requests.
- [ ] Material sustainability claims are evidence-based or clearly marked as uncertain.

## Testing

Describe tests, benchmark cases, or examples used to validate the change.

## Compatibility

Does this change alter a public interface, schema, prompt contract, benchmark expectation, or adoption guide? If yes, explain.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests/benchmarks when behavior changed.
- [ ] I have not claimed endorsement by the Holy See, an AI lab, or another institution without verifiable evidence.
